learning_objective: See why 1 + 3 + 5 + … + 7 = 4² by wrapping L-shaped layers around a square.

definitions.meaning: a whole number of the form 2k − 1: 1, 3, 5, 7, …
n × n, the number of cells in an n by n square

steps: Wrap 3 more squares around it to make a 2 by 2 square of 4.
Wrap 5 more squares around it to make a 3 by 3 square of 9.
Wrap 7 more squares around it to make a 4 by 4 square of 16.
Adding the first 4 odd numbers always gives a perfect square: 4 squared.
conclusion: The first 4 odd numbers add up to 4² = 16.
